description_en: Queries statistics about the slow log trends for a cluster
description_zh: 查看集群慢日志趋势统计情况
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse describe-slow-log-trend --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id cc-bp11xxl475ui80000 --start-time 2022-05-20_16:00:00 --end-time 2022-05-27_16:00:00 --query-duration-ms 1000 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSlowLogTrend

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html operation to query information about all clusters in a specific region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html接口查询目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the \`yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss\` format. The time is in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the \`yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss\` format. The time is in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The time range cannot exceed 7 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss（UTC时间）。
查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，且与查询开始时间间隔小于7天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The execution duration of a slow SQL query, in milliseconds. The minimum value is 1000. The default value is 1000. The operation returns slow SQL queries that take longer than this duration to execute
parameters.help_zh: 慢SQL的执行耗时。最小值为1000，默认值为1000。单位：毫秒。返回参数将返回超过该耗时的慢SQL
parameters.name: query_duration_ms

SlowLogTrend.description_en: The result set of the slow SQL queries

ResultSet.description_en: The list of slow SQL queries

items.description_en: The list of slow SQL queries

AvgQueryDurationMs.description_en: The average execution duration. Unit: milliseconds
AvgQueryDurationMs.description_zh: 平均执行耗时。单位：毫秒

Count.description_en: The total execution duration of slow SQL queries. Unit: milliseconds
Count.description_zh: 慢SQL执行耗时的总和。单位：毫秒

MaxQueryDurationMs.description_en: The longest execution duration. Unit: milliseconds
MaxQueryDurationMs.description_zh: 最长执行耗时。单位：毫秒

MinQueryDurationMs.description_en: The shortest execution duration. Unit: milliseconds
MinQueryDurationMs.description_zh: 最短执行耗时。单位：毫秒

QueryStartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The time is in the \`yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss\` format. The time is in UTC
QueryStartTime.description_zh: 查询开始的时间。格式：yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss（UTC时间）

Rows.description_en: The number of rows in the result set

RowsBeforeLimitAtLeast.description_en: The minimum number of rows that are returned before the \`LIMIT\` clause is applied

Statistics.description_en: The statistics of the query results

BytesRead.description_en: The amount of data read. Unit: bytes
BytesRead.description_zh: 读取的数据量大小。单位：Byte

ElapsedTime.description_en: The query execution duration. Unit: seconds
